_comment: Named-variety preserve lexicon (layer L3 of the merge gate) for sub-threshold variants (n < 20). These are foreign-language or geographic product varieties whose tiny support makes them statistically untestable (null95 at n=20 is 0.169 bits) but whose raw cuisine concentrations are extreme (80-100%). A default-merge would silently delete near-perfect cuisine markers. Phrases are matched with word boundaries against the cleaned variant (never substring: 'tamarind' must not match 'tamari'). Entries sorted by phrase.
